dataset_name: WorldHeritage Somali Historical Knowledge Base — Starter Batch 2
purpose: Additional Somali history research records for editorial review; not historically verified or ready for publication.

import_policy.note: Source links are starting points. Each claim still requires a reviewer to check the source and its context.

sources.title: Somalia Human Development Report 2001: Human Rights and Governance
sources.author: United Nations Development Programme, Somalia
sources.notes: Historical chronology, appendix p. 213 (PDF p. 215); institutional synthesis. Check cited event context against independent sources.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969–1976, Volume E-5, Part 1, Document 287
sources.author: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.notes: Contemporaneous U.S. government analysis referring to the 1964 border war; reflects a diplomatic perspective.

sources.title: A Revolution of Letters: Text, Sight and Spectacle in Socialist Somalia
sources.author: Safia Aidid
sources.notes: The American Historical Review, 131(3), 891–921. Research on Somali orthography, literacy campaigns, and state-building; also discusses unequal effects on Af-Maay and minority language communities, and Somali historical writing. Check article sections and page references.

sources.title: Nomads Trading with Empires: Intercultural Trade in Ancient Somaliland in the First to Seventh Centuries CE
sources.author: American Journal of Archaeology
sources.notes: Archaeological and textual synthesis; sites, identifications, and interpretations have different certainty levels. See sections on the Periplus, Ras Hafun, Xiis, Ceel Gerdi, and Berbera region.

sources.title: Somalia, 1992–1993
sources.author: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.notes: Chronology and U.S. policy perspective on Somalia, UNOSOM, UNITAF, and the 1993 battle; pair with Somali and UN sources.

sources.title: Security Council Resolution 751 (1992)
sources.author: United Nations Security Council
sources.notes: Primary document establishing UNOSOM I; review the resolution text and mandate directly.

sources.title: United Nations Operation in Somalia II: Resolutions and Background
sources.author: United Nations Peacekeeping
sources.notes: Mission chronology and mandate, including Resolution 814 (1993) and the mission's stated objectives; institutional account.

sources.title: Report on the activities of the Office of the United Nations Disaster Relief Coordinator, 1974–1975
sources.author: United Nations Disaster Relief Coordinator
sources.notes: Lists a November 1974 emergency allocation for drought in Somalia; does not by itself describe the drought's national scale or all impacts.

sources.title: Report of the Administrator of the United Nations Development Programme
sources.author: United Nations Development Programme
sources.notes: Retrospective summary reports that the 1974–75 drought affected nomadic communities and describes assistance/resettlement; verify the estimate, geographic scope, and language in the full report.

sources.title: OAU Charter and Member States
sources.author: African Union
sources.notes: Lists Somalia's date of joining the OAU predecessor as 25 May 1963 and provides the organization's founding context.

records.title_so: Dagaalkii xuduudda Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ee 1964
records.title_en: The 1964 Somalia–Ethiopia border war
records.summary_so: Diiwaanno diblomaasiyadeed oo Maraykan ah waxay xusaan dagaal xuduudeed oo kooban oo dhex maray Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya 1964. Faahfaahinta bilowga, goobaha iyo dhinacyada ku lugta lahaa waxay u baahan yihiin in lala barbar dhigo ilo kale.
records.body_so: Xusuus-qor diblomaasiyadeed oo Maraykan ah oo la qoray 1969 ayaa dib u xusaya iska horimaadyo joogto ahaa oo ka dhacay Ogaden horraantii 1960-meeyadii, kuna soo gebagebeeyey dagaal xuduudeed oo kooban 1964. Qoraalku wuxuu ka tarjumayaa aragtida diblomaasiyadda Maraykanka; waa in lala hubiyaa diiwaanno Itoobiyaan, Soomaali iyo cilmi-baaris madax-bannaan. Goobta, sababta iyo khasaaraha laguma faahfaahin diiwaankan oo keliya.

source_claim_notes.b2_frus64: Xusuus-qorku wuxuu sheegaa dagaal xuduudeed oo kooban 1964; xaqiiji taariikhaha iyo goobaha ilaha kale.

records.notes: Sheegashada iyo erayga 'dagaal' dib ha u eego taariikhyahan; qoraalka isha ee Maraykanku waa aragti dibadeed.

records.title_so: Dilkii madaxweyne Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke
records.title_en: The assassination of President Abdirashid Ali Sharmarke
records.summary_so: Warbixin taariikheed oo Qaramada Midoobay ah waxay diiwaangelisaa in Madaxweyne Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke la dilay 15 Oktoobar 1969. Dhacdadan iyo xaaladdeeda siyaasadeed waa in lagu sii baaraa ilo kala duwan.
records.body_so: Warbixinta UNDP ee Soomaaliya waxay taariikhda dilka madaxweyne Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke ku sheegtaa 15 Oktoobar 1969. Lix maalmood kaddib waxaa dhacay afgambigii milateriga ee xogta batch-kii koowaad daboolay. Isku xigxiga taariikhuhu ma caddaynayo in dilku keligiis sababay afgambiga; xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo faahfaahinta dilka waxay u baahan yihiin tixraacyo kale.

source_claim_notes.b2_unhdr: Jadwalka taariikhda, PDF p. 215, wuxuu qorayaa 15 Oktoobar 1969; xaqiiji ilaha madax-bannaan.

records.notes: Kala saar xaqiiqda taariikhda, duruufaha dilka iyo fasiraadda saamayntiisa.

records.title_so: Ku biiristii Soomaaliya ee Ururka Midowga Afrika (OAU)
records.title_en: Somalia joins the Organization of African Unity
records.summary_so: Liiska rasmiga ah ee Midowga Afrika wuxuu qorayaa 25 May 1963 inay ahayd taariikhda Soomaaliya ku biirtay OAU. OAU waxay ahayd ururkii ka horreeyey Midowga Afrika ee maanta jira.
records.body_so: Diiwaanka xubnaha ee Midowga Afrika wuxuu Soomaaliya ku qorayaa inay ku biirtay OAU 25 May 1963, maalintii lagu aasaasay ururkaas Addis Ababa. Maqaalka kama sii bixinayo doorkii Soomaaliya ee wadaxaajoodyadii aasaaska, maadaama taas u baahan tahay ilal iyo dukumentiyo gaar ah.

source_claim_notes.b2_au_oau: Bogga AU wuxuu qorayaa taariikhda ku biirista 25 May 1963; tixraac dukumentiyada OAU ee asalka ah.

records.notes: Kala saar ku biirista Soomaaliya iyo maalinta aasaaska OAU; xaqiiji higaadda magacyada rasmiga ah.

records.title_so: Guddigii qorista Af-Soomaaliga ee 1971
records.title_en: The 1971 Somali orthography committee
records.summary_so: Daraasad aqooneed waxay sheegaysaa in 1971 la magacaabay guddi 21 xubnood ah oo dib u eegay higgaadda Af-Soomaaliga. Xulashooyinka far-qoraalka iyo dooddii ka horreysay waxay lahaayeen taariikh ka dheer hal go'aan dowladeed.
records.body_so: Maqaalka American Historical Review wuxuu tilmaamayaa in 1971 dowladdu magacawday guddi 21 xubnood ah oo ka shaqeeyey arrinta far-qoraalka. Qoraagu wuxuu guddigaas ku xiraa dood dadweyne oo sannado badan socotay, iyo doorarkii culimo, suugaan-yahanno iyo aqoonyahanno. Magacyada xubnaha, hab-raaca guddiga iyo aragtiyaha kala duwan waa in laga hubiyaa maqaalka iyo dukumentiyada asalka ah ka hor inta aan xogtan loo qaadan mid dhammaystiran.

source_claim_notes.b2_ahr: Maqaalku wuxuu sheegayaa guddi 21 xubnood ah oo la magacaabay 1971; dib u eeg magacyada iyo bogga saxda ah.

records.notes: Maqaal aqooneed keliya ayaa hadda ku xiran; raadi doodaha iyo dukumentiyada dhinacyada kala duwan.

records.title_so: Ololihii wax-akhriska miyiga ee Af-Soomaaliga
records.title_en: The rural Somali literacy campaign
records.summary_so: Cilmi-baaris ku saabsan qorista Af-Soomaaliga waxay ka hadlaysaa ololihii wax-akhriska ee miyiga ee billowday 1974. Ololuhu wuxuu qayb ka ahaa siyaasad dowladeed oo luqad, waxbarasho iyo dowlad-dhis isku xirtay.
records.body_so: Maqaalka American Historical Review wuxuu tilmaamayaa in, kaddib ololihii magaalooyinka, dowladdu 1974 u jeesatay ololaha wax-akhriska miyiga. Qoraagu wuxuu sharxayaa in arday, macallimiin iyo shaqaale dowladeed loo diray goobaha miyiga, isla markaana dhaqanka afka iyo suugaanta laga diiwaangeliyey. Maqaalka wuxuu kaloo falanqeeyaa ujeeddooyinka siyaasadeed ee xukuumaddii xilligaas; guusha ololaha iyo tirakoobyada akhris-qoraalka waa in si gaar ah looga xaqiijiyaa xogta asalka ah.

source_claim_notes.b2_ahr: Qaybta ololaha miyiga waxay tilmaamaysaa 1974; tirooyinka iyo natiijooyinka waxay u baahan yihiin hubin gaar ah.

records.notes: Ku dar aragtiyada bulshooyinka miyiga iyo xusuusaha afka ah marka dib loo baarayo.

records.title_so: Abaartii Soomaaliya ee 1974–1975
records.title_en: The 1974–1975 drought in Somalia
records.summary_so: Dukumenti gargaar oo Qaramada Midoobay ah wuxuu diiwaangeliyey codsi iyo qoondayn gargaar oo Soomaaliya la xiriirtay abaar dabayaaqadii 1974. Warbixin dambe oo UNDP ah waxay ka hadlaysaa saamaynta abaarta iyo barnaamijyada dejinta, balse qiyaasaha iyo juqraafiyadda waa in si taxaddar leh loo hubiyaa.
records.body_so: Diiwaanka UNDRO ee 1974–1975 wuxuu xusaa qoondayn gargaar oo Soomaaliya loogu sameeyey xaalad abaar bishii Nofeembar 1974. Warbixin UNDP oo 1983 ah waxay si dib-u-eegis ah u sheegtaa in abaartii 1974–1975 saamaysay dad reer guuraa ah ayna jireen barnaamijyo dejin iyo gargaar. Labadan dukumenti waxay xaqiijinayaan in xaalad gargaar la diiwaangeliyey, laakiin kelidood kuma filna in lagu go'aamiyo baaxadda, gobollada ay sida daran u saamaysay ama tirada dadka. Xogtaas waa in lagu barbar dhigo cilmi-baaris deegaan-gaar ah iyo markhaatiyo.
records.region: Somalia; regions and communities require further documentation

source_claim_notes.b2_undro: Diiwaanka gurmadka wuxuu qorayaa qoondayn abaar oo Nofeembar 1974; ma cabbirayo saamaynta guud.
source_claim_notes.b2_un_drought: Warbixinta 1983 waxay bixisaa qiyaaso iyo sharaxaad dib-u-eegis ah; xaqiiji tirada iyo baaxadda.
source_claim_notes.b2_unhdr: Jadwalka wuxuu xusaa abaarta 1974–75; adeegsiga xogtan wuxuu u baahan yahay tixraacyo dheeraad ah.

records.notes: Arrin nololeed oo xasaasi ah: hubi saamaynta bulshooyinka, kala duwanaanshaha gobollada iyo tirooyinka ka hor isticmaalka.

records.title_so: Ku biiristii Soomaaliya ee Jaamacadda Carabta
records.title_en: Somalia joins the League of Arab States
records.summary_so: Warbixin UNDP ah waxay 1974 ku taariikhaysaa ku biiristii Soomaaliya ee Jaamacadda Carabta. Taariikhda rasmiga ah ee xubinnimada iyo duruufaha diblomaasiyadeed waxay u baahan yihiin diiwaanka ururka laftiisa.
records.body_so: Jadwalka ku jira Somalia Human Development Report 2001 wuxuu qorayaa in Soomaaliya ku biirtay League of Arab States 1974. Qoraalka halkan wuxuu diiwaangelinayaa taariikhda guud oo keliya; taariikhda saxda ah, dukumentiga codsiga, iyo doodaha ku saabsan aqoonsiga ama aqoonsiga dhaqan-bulsheed laguma xaqiijin warbixintan oo keliya.

source_claim_notes.b2_unhdr: Jadwalka PDF p. 215 wuxuu qorayaa ku biirista 1974; xaqiiji diiwaanka League of Arab States.

records.notes: Ka fogow in xubinnimada urur loo fasirto hal aqoonsi dhaqameed ama siyaasadeed.

records.title_so: Isku daygii afgambiga ee Abriil 1978
records.title_en: The April 1978 coup attempt
records.summary_so: Jadwalka warbixinta UNDP wuxuu xusaa isku day afgambi oo fashilmay Abriil 1978. Warbixintu waxay ku xireysaa qaar ka mid ah saraakiishii ka qaybgalay samaysankii jabhad mucaarad ah, xiriir u baahan xaqiijin iyo faahfaahin dheeraad ah.
records.body_so: Somalia Human Development Report 2001 waxay sheegaysaa in isku day afgambi oo ay sameeyeen saraakiil milateri uu fashilmay Abriil 1978, kadibna saraakiil mucaarad ahi sameeyeen Somali Salvation Front. Tani waa dulmar kooban oo ka yimid warbixin dambe; liiska dadka, waxa dhacay, iyo xiriirka ururradii mucaaradka ee xigay waa in laga hubiyaa ilo madax-bannaan, oo ay ku jiraan xusuus-qorayaal iyo daraasado cilmiyeed.

source_claim_notes.b2_unhdr: Jadwalka PDF p. 215 wuxuu sheegaa Abriil 1978 iyo ururka mucaaradka; faahfaahinta dib u eeg.

records.notes: Mawduuc siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah; ha isku darin ururro kala duwan adoon hubin taariikhda iyo xubnaha.

records.title_so: Bixitaankii xukuumaddii dhexe ee Muqdisho 1991
records.title_en: The fall of the central government in Mogadishu in 1991
records.summary_so: Dulmar taariikheed oo Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda Maraykanku wuxuu sheegayaa in xoogag mucaarad ahi ka saareen Maxamed Siyaad Barre Muqdisho Janaayo 1991, dabadeedna uusan markiiba samaysmin dowlad dhexe oo beddesha.
records.body_so: Office of the Historian wuxuu dhacdooyinka Janaayo 1991 ku tilmaamaa in kooxo mucaarad ahi si wadajir ah Barre uga saareen Muqdisho, isla markaana aanay markiiba jirin dowlad dhexe oo dib u samaysantay. Waa in weedhaas lala barbar dhigo aragtiyo iyo diiwaanno Soomaaliyeed, lagana taxaddaraa in loo soo koobo isbeddel siyaasadeed oo leh jilayaal iyo waayo-aragnimo goboleed kala duwan.

source_claim_notes.b2_us1993: Dulmarku wuxuu sheegaa in Barre Muqdisho laga saaray Janaayo 1991; isha waa aragti dibadeed.
source_claim_notes.b2_unosom2: Taariikhda UN waxay ku bilaabataa burburkii xukuumadda 1991; xaqiiji oo la barbar dhig.

records.notes: Ka fogow hal taariikh ama hal dhacdo oo lagu matalo dhammaan kala-guurka iyo colaadaha.

records.title_so: Aasaaskii hawlgalka UNOSOM I
records.title_en: Establishment of UNOSOM I
records.summary_so: Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay wuxuu qaraarka 751 ku aasaasay hawlgalka UNOSOM bishii Abriil 1992. Qaraarku waa il rasmi ah oo ku saabsan go'aanka iyo waajibaadka ururka, balse ma daboolayo aragtida dhammaan Soomaalida.
records.body_so: Qaraarka Golaha Ammaanka ee 751 (1992) waa diiwaanka aasaasiga ah ee hawlgalka UNOSOM I. Qoraalka go'aanka waa in si toos ah loo akhriyaa si loo kala saaro waajibaadka rasmiga ah, duruufaha gargaarka bani'aadamnimo, iyo natiijooyinka dhabta ah ee hawlgalka. Diiwaankan ma sheeganayo in hawlgalku xalliyey colaadda ama in dhammaan dhinacyadu isku si u arkeen.

source_claim_notes.b2_unosom1: Qaraarka 751 (1992) waa il rasmi ah oo lagu hubinayo aasaaska iyo waajibaadka UNOSOM I.
source_claim_notes.b2_us1993: Dulmarka wuxuu bixiyaa taariikhda hawlgalka, balse ka tarjumaya aragti Maraykan.

records.notes: Dib u eeg taariikhda go'aanka, erayada mandate-ka iyo xaaladda bani'aadamnimo ilaha asalka ah.

records.title_so: Hawlgalka UNITAF iyo gargaarkii Restore Hope
records.title_en: UNITAF and Operation Restore Hope
records.summary_so: Dukumentiyada Qaramada Midoobay iyo dulmar diblomaasiyadeed waxay tilmaamayaan in hawlgalka UNITAF ee Maraykanku hoggaaminayey bilaabmay Diseembar 1992 si loo taageero gargaarka bani'aadamnimo. Ujeeddooyinka, oggolaanshaha iyo saamaynta waa in si gooni ah loo qiimeeyaa.
records.body_so: Office of the Historian wuxuu sheegayaa in Diseembar 1992 Maraykanku bilaabay Operation Restore Hope, oo qayb ka ahaa hawlgal ballaaran oo UN ah, si loo taageero gaarsiinta gargaarka. Qaramada Midoobay waxay bixisaa diiwaanka qaraarrada iyo waajibaadka UNITAF. Qoraalka taariikhiga ah waa inuu kala saaraa go'aanka Golaha Ammaanka, magaca hawlgalka Maraykanka, waayo-aragnimada dadka deegaanka iyo doodaha ku saabsan adeegsiga awood ciidan.

source_claim_notes.b2_us1993: Taariikhda bilowga Restore Hope iyo sharaxaadda siyaasadda Maraykanka; ku lammaani qaraarrada UN.
source_claim_notes.b2_unosom1: Qaraarrada UN waa saldhigga sharciyeed; Resolution 794 (1992) sidoo kale hubi.

records.notes: Ilaha hadda jira waxay u janjeeraan hay'adaha caalamiga ah; ku dar taariikhda Soomaalida iyo qiimeyn madax-bannaan.

records.title_so: U-beddeliddii UNOSOM I ee UNOSOM II
records.title_en: Transition from UNOSOM I to UNOSOM II
records.summary_so: Golaha Ammaanka wuxuu 26 Maarso 1993 ansixiyey qaraarka 814, kaas oo ballaariyey waajibaadka iyo awoodda UNOSOM II. Qaraarka iyo natiijooyinka hawlgalka waa laba arrimood oo kala duwan.
records.body_so: Bogga Qaramada Midoobay ee UNOSOM II wuxuu sheegayaa in Golaha Ammaanku 26 Maarso 1993 ansixiyey Resolution 814 oo ballaariyey hawlgalka. Diiwaanka UN wuxuu qeexayaa waajibaadka ururka ee amniga gargaarka, dib-u-heshiisiinta iyo dib-u-dhiska hay'adaha. Qoraalka halkan wuxuu soo koobayaa go'aanka rasmiga ah oo keliya; qiimeynta sida waajibaadka loo fuliyey waxay u baahan tahay ilo kala duwan iyo aragtiyo Soomaali ah.

source_claim_notes.b2_unosom2: Diiwaanka UN wuxuu sheegaa in Resolution 814 la ansixiyey 26 Maarso 1993; waa in qaraarka laftiisa la akhriyaa.
source_claim_notes.b2_us1993: Dulmar dhinaca Maraykanka ah oo ku saabsan kala-guurka UNOSOM II.

records.notes: Shaqada UN iyo natiijooyinkeeda waa arrin laga dooday; ku dar ilo Soomaali iyo daraasado madax-bannaan.

records.title_so: Dagaalkii Muqdisho ee 3 Oktoobar 1993
records.title_en: The battle in Mogadishu on 3 October 1993
records.summary_so: Office of the Historian wuxuu xusaa in 3 Oktoobar 1993 dagaal Muqdisho ka dhacay oo ay ku dhinteen askar Maraykan ah iyo Soomaali badan. Tirada dhimashada Soomaalida ilahani si isku mid ah uma diiwaangeliyaan, waana in la baaro.
records.body_so: Dulmarka Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda Maraykanku wuxuu sheegayaa in 3 Oktoobar 1993 dagaal Muqdisho ka dhacay, laba helicopter Black Hawk la soo riday, 18 askari oo Maraykan ahna dhinteen; wuxuu sidoo kale adeegsadaa qiyaas ah boqolaal Soomaali ah. Qiyaasta dhimashada Soomaalida waa in aan la qaadan iyadoo aan la barbar dhigin diiwaanno kale. Qoraalku waa aragti Maraykan oo ku wajahan dhacdada; waxaa loo baahan yahay xusuus-qorayaal, warbaahin Soomaali iyo cilmi-baaris madax-bannaan.

source_claim_notes.b2_us1993: Dulmarku wuxuu qorayaa dhacdada, 18 askari oo Maraykan ah iyo qiyaas aan qeexnayn oo dhimashada Soomaalida ah.
source_claim_notes.b2_unosom2: Diiwaanka UN wuxuu xusaa weerarro iyo isbeddellada mandate-ka; xaqiiji xiriirka iyo taariikhaha.

records.notes: Tirada Soomaalida ku dhimatay way muran iyo kala duwanaansho leedahay; ha soo bandhigin qiyaas keliya xaqiiqo kama dambays ah.

records.title_so: Dhammaadkii hawlgalka UNOSOM II ee Soomaaliya
records.title_en: The end of UNOSOM II in Somalia
records.summary_so: Qaramada Midoobay waxay hawlgalka UNOSOM II ku taxdaa inuu dhammaaday Maarso 1995. Taariikhda dhammaadka rasmiga ahi kama dhigna in colaadda ama baahida gargaarku dhammaatay.
records.body_so: Diiwaanka hawlgalladii hore ee UN Peacekeeping wuxuu UNOSOM II ku taxaa Maarso 1993 ilaa Maarso 1995. Golaha Ammaanku wuxuu Resolution 954 (1994) ku dejiyey dhammaadka muddada waajibaadka hawlgalka. Taariikhda rasmiga ahi waxay tilmaamaysaa dhammaadka hawlgalka hay'adeed, mana ka dhigna dhammaadka colaadaha, barakaca ama hawlaha gargaarka.

source_claim_notes.b2_unosom2: Diiwaanka UN Peacekeeping wuxuu taxaa muddada Maarso 1993 ilaa Maarso 1995; Resolution 954 hubi.
source_claim_notes.b2_us1993: Office of the Historian wuxuu qorayaa in UN ka baxday Maarso 1995; ka fiirso ereyga 'withdrawal'.

records.notes: Kala saar dhammaadka mandate-ka, bixitaanka ciidamada iyo sii socoshada dhibaatooyinka gudaha.

records.title_so: Ganacsigii badda ee xeebta waqooyi ee Soomaaliyeed xilliyadii hore
records.title_en: Ancient maritime trade on the northern Somali coast
records.summary_so: Daraasad qadiimiga ah waxay isku dartaa qoraalka Periplus iyo raadadka Xiis, Daamo, Ras Xaafuun iyo Berbera si ay u baarto xiriirradii ganacsi ee qarniyadii hore. Aqoonsiga dekedaha magacyada qadiimiga ah qaarkood waa fasiraad aqooneed, mana aha mid dhammaanteed la hubo.
records.body_so: Maqaal 2022 ah oo ku jira American Journal of Archaeology wuxuu falanqeeyaa xiriirka xeebta waqooyi ee Soomaaliyeed la lahayd ganacsiga Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya qarniyadii 1aad ilaa 7aad CE. Qorayaashu waxay is barbar dhigaan dekedo uu Periplus xusay iyo goobaha Xiis, Daamo, Ras Xaafuun iyo Berbera, iyagoo soo bandhigaya raadad dhoobo, galaas iyo alaabo kale oo dibadda ka yimid. Aqoonsiyada dekedaha iyo fasiraadda shabakadaha ganacsi waxay leeyihiin heerar hubanti kala duwan; qoraalku waa inuu taas muujiyaa.

source_claim_notes.b2_aja: Maqaalku wuxuu soo bandhigayaa Periplus iyo caddaynta qadiimiga ah; kala saar qoraal qadiimi ah iyo fasiraadda goobta.

records.notes: Xilliga bilowga/dhammaadka waa ballaarin qiyaaseed oo ku salaysan cinwaanka maqaalka; ku beddel dateDisplay qaab si sax ah u muujinaya 1aad–7aad CE marka la tafatirayo.

records.title_so: Raadadka ganacsi iyo dhoobada dibadda laga keenay ee Ras Xaafuun
records.title_en: Imported trade goods and archaeological evidence at Ras Hafun
records.summary_so: Qodista Ras Xaafuun waxay heshay dhoobo iyo weelal laga keenay meelo kala duwan, oo lagu taariikheeyey xilliyo ka bilaabma ka hor CE ilaa qarniyo hore CE. Alaabtu waxay muujinaysaa xiriir fog, balse ma caddaynayso keligeed cidda maamushay ganacsiga ama aqoonsiga ganacsatada.
records.body_so: Daraasadda qadiimiga ahi waxay kala saartaa laba goobood oo Ras Xaafuun ah: Hafun West oo leh dhoobo dibadda laga keenay laga bilaabo qarnigii 1aad BCE ilaa qarnigii 3aad CE, iyo Hafun Main oo leh agab qarnigii 2aad ilaa 5aad CE. Qorayaashu waxay xusaan amphorae Roomaan, dhoobo glazed ah oo Parthian-Sassanian ah iyo alaab Hindi ah. Taariikhaha iyo fasiraadda xiriirka ganacsi waa in lagu xiraa goobta qodista iyo liiska alaabta; ma aha caddayn ku filan oo lagu sheegayo xukun siyaasadeed ama aqoonsi qowmiyadeed.

source_claim_notes.b2_aja: Qaybta archaeology-ga Ras Hafun waxay taxaysaa goobaha Hafun West/Main iyo agabka; hubi taariikhda muunad kasta.

records.notes: Xuduudaha year numbers waa soo-koobid aad u ballaaran; taariikhaha daraasadda asalka ah ha la sii hayo marka la tafatirayo.

records.title_so: Xiis iyo raadadka dekedaha xeebta ee waayihii hore
records.title_en: Xiis and archaeological evidence of ancient coastal exchange
records.summary_so: Daraasad qadiimiga ahi waxay Xiis ku xustaa agab galaas Roomaan ah oo la helay qarnigii 19aad, iyo qabuuraha cairn-ka ee daraasadaha dambe. Xiriirka magacyada dekedaha Periplus iyo goobaha maanta jira wuxuu leeyahay fasiraado kala duwan.
records.body_so: Maqaalka American Journal of Archaeology wuxuu diiwaangeliyaa in Georges Révoil uu Xiis ka helay galaas Roomaan ah oo lagu taariikheeyey qarnigii 1aad ama 2aad CE. Daraasaddu sidoo kale waxay ka hadlaysaa necropolis-ka Xiis, noocyada cairn-ka iyo suuragalnimada in goobtu qayb ka ahayd shabakadaha ganacsi ee gobolka. Qorayaashu waxay kala saaraan caddaynta la helay iyo mala-awaalka ku saabsan xiriirka dekedaha qadiimiga ah; kala duwanaanshahaas waa in lagu ilaaliyo qoraalka.

source_claim_notes.b2_aja: Maqaalku wuxuu xusaa galaaskii laga helay Xiis iyo necropolis-ka; aqoonsiga Mundu/Xiis waa fasiraad oo dib u eeg.

records.notes: Natiijooyinkani waxay ku saabsan yihiin goob gaar ah; ha guudmarin dhammaan xeebaha ama dadka deegaanka.

records.title_so: Berbera, Siyaara iyo xarumaha ganacsiga ee xeebta waqooyi
records.title_en: Berbera, Siyaara and trade sites on the northern coast
records.summary_so: Daraasadda AJA waxay soo sheegtaa goobo ganacsi oo agagaarka Berbera laga helay, qaarna taariikhdooda la gaarsiiyey qarniyadii dhexe. Qorayaashu waxay ka digayaan in deked keliya si fudud loogu aqoonsado meelaha Periplus sheegay.
records.body_so: Maqaalka archaeological-ga ahi wuxuu ka hadlaa raadad ganacsi oo agagaarka Berbera laga helay, oo ay ku jiraan goobo la isticmaali jiray qarnigii 11aad iyo ka dambe. Qorayaashu waxay sharxayaan in magacyada iyo tilmaamaha Periplus aysan si fudud ula jaanqaadin Berbera maanta, waxayna soo jeedinayaan in loo fikiro gobol xeebeed iyo meelo kala duwan oo lagu soo xirto maraakiibta. Sidaas darteed, qoraalkani ma sheegayo in aqoonsiga dekedda qadiimiga ahi yahay mid la isku raacsan yahay.

source_claim_notes.b2_aja: Qaybaha Berbera iyo Siyaara waxay kala dhigaan caddaynta iyo doodda aqoonsiga goobaha; hubi taariikhaha saxda ah.

records.notes: Waqtiga guud halkan waa ballaaran; ku beddel xilliga gaarka ah ee claim kasta marka la tafatirayo.

records.title_so: Halbeeggii Af-Maxaa Tiri iyo luqadaha aan mudnaanta helin
records.title_en: The standardized Somali orthography and underrepresented languages
records.summary_so: Daraasad cusub oo ku saabsan qoraalka Af-Soomaaliga waxay sheegaysaa in halbeegga dowladdu xoojisay Af-Maxaa Tiri, halka Af-Maay iyo luqado kale oo laga hadlo Soomaaliya aysan helin isla fursaddii waxbarasho iyo daabacaad.
records.body_so: Safia Aidid waxay maqaalkeeda ku falanqaynaysaa sida qorista iyo halbeegga Af-Soomaaligu qayb uga noqdeen dhismaha qaranka iyo awoodda dowladeed. Maqaalku wuxuu tilmaamayaa in Af-Maxaa Tiri la jaangooyey oo lagu xoojiyey daabacaadda, dugsiyada iyo maamulka, halka Af-Maay—oo ay ku hadlaan bulshooyin badan oo beeraley-xoolo-dhaqato ah oo koonfurta jooga—iyo luqado kale oo laga hadlo Soomaaliya aysan helin fursado la mid ah. Waa fasiraad cilmiyeed oo u baahan in lala akhriyo aragtiyaha bulshada Af-Maay iyo ilo kale oo luqadeed.

source_claim_notes.b2_ahr: Qaybta qoraalka iyo daabacaadda waxay ka hadlaysaa Af-Maxaa Tiri, Af-Maay iyo luqadaha laga tiro badan yahay; hubi bogagga 166–167 iyo daraasadaha kale.

records.notes: Diiwaankan wuxuu si ula kac ah u iftiiminayaa saameyn luqadeed oo u baahan codadka iyo aqoonta dadka ay khusayso.

records.title_so: Diiwaangelinta suugaanta afka iyo qoraalka taariikhda Soomaalida
records.title_en: Recording oral literature and writing Somali history
records.summary_so: Cilmi-baaris ku saabsan isbeddelkii qorista Af-Soomaaliga waxay ka hadlaysaa ururinta gabayada Sayid Maxamed Cabdulle Xasan iyo qoraallo kale oo suugaan iyo taariikh ah intii lagu jiray 1970-meeyadii.
records.body_so: Maqaalka Safia Aidid wuxuu xusaa in Akadeemiyaha Dhaqanka la aasaasay 1973, qoraayaashana la siiyey taageero ay ku qoraan taariikh, maanso iyo sheekooyin. Waxa kale oo uu tilmaamayaa ururin gabayadii Sayid Maxamed Cabdulle Xasan oo 1974 laga soo diyaariyey wareysiyo afka ah oo lala yeeshay halgamayaal Daraawiish ah muddo dheer. Tani waxay muujinaysaa xiriir dhex maray xusuusta afka iyo qoraalka, balse ururintaas waa hal dariiq oo xusuusta loo diiwaangeliyey; cidda la wareystay, habka tifaftirka iyo waxyaabaha laga tegay waxay u baahan yihiin baadhitaan.

source_claim_notes.b2_ahr: Qaybta Academy of Culture waxay xustaa aasaaskii 1973 iyo ururinta maansadii 1974; hubi qoraallada asalka ah iyo bogagga 196–198.

records.notes: Kala saar taariikhda hay'adda, buug kasta oo ay soo saartay iyo xusuusta afka ee xogta laga soo ururiyey.

records.title_so: Ololaha far-qoraalka iyo dooddii qoraalka Af-Soomaaliga
records.title_en: The debate over writing Somali
records.summary_so: Daraasad aqooneed waxay diiwaangelisaa dood dheer oo ku saabsan in Af-Soomaaliga lagu qoro fartee, iyadoo xulashooyinka iyo aragtiyuhu la xiriireen taariikhda gumeysiga, diinta, waxbarashada iyo siyaasadda qaranka.
records.body_so: Safia Aidid waxay tilmaamaysaa in ka hor go'aankii rasmiga ahaa ee 1972, Soomaalidu ka doodayeen habab kala duwan oo Af-Soomaaliga loo qoro, ayna jireen diidmooyin ku wajahan faraha qaarkood sababo la xiriira taariikhda iyo siyaasadda. Qoraagu wuxuu soo bandhigayaa sida afka, qoraalka iyo qaran-dhisiddu isugu xidhmeen, wuxuuna sharxayaa in go'aanka xukuumaddu aanu tirtirin kala duwanaanshihii iyo saamayntii ka dhalatay. Diiwaankani waa dulmar ka yimid hal daraasad; dhinacyada doodda waa in lagu xoojiyaa qoraallada iyo codadka xilligaas.
records.region: Somali-speaking communities in the Horn of Africa

source_claim_notes.b2_ahr: Maqaalku wuxuu dib u eegayaa doodda higgaadda ka hor 1972; hubi bogagga hordhaca iyo doodaha uu xiganayo.

records.notes: Ha soo koobin taariikhda luqadda oo dhan go'aankii 1972; ku dar qoraallo ka horreeyey iyo aragtiyo kala duwan.
